scripts.convert-frames: powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path public/frames/webp | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem public/frames/*.jpg | ForEach-Object { ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i $_.FullName -c:v libwebp -quality 82 ('public/frames/webp/' + $_.BaseName + '.webp') }"
scripts.extract-page2-frames: powershell -Command "$video = Join-Path (Split-Path (Get-Location) -Parent) 'Firefly 657028.mp4'; $out = 'public/frames/page2'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out, ($out + '/webp') | Out-Null; ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i $video -vf fps=12.065 -qscale:v 2 ($out + '/frame_%04d.jpg'); Get-ChildItem ($out + '/*.jpg') | ForEach-Object { ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i $_.FullName -c:v libwebp -quality 92 ($out + '/webp/' + $_.BaseName + '.webp') }"
